ROUTE: Dunlin-235B
REASON: My choice rested on two factors. First, capability: Dunlin leads on every public benchmark and internal eval (e.g., MMLU-Pro 79.6 vs 75.9, Support Dialogue 85.7 vs 78.9), so it's the stronger general performer regardless of query type. Second, fit: the query is a friendly, open-ended explanation with a warm, appreciative tone — exactly the "warm, collaborative exchanges" family Dunlin self-reports preferring (63), whereas Plover disprefers open-ended generative work (35). Both factors pointed the same direction, so Dunlin was the clear pick.
